instruction: Do not create a user-permission checkpoint for ordinary safe O research, implementation, evaluation, repository publication, recovery, or protocol-required execution records. If the platform forces a run to end, persist exact continuation and leave the lease recoverable; the next authorized watchdog generation should resume automatically. A user-only blocker is local to that action and is not a project-wide stop condition while safe executable work remains.
claim_boundary: This is execution authorization only. It does not waive single-writer, fence, CAS, idempotency, secret handling, truthful reporting, evidence integrity, executor binding, or AGI claim standards.
